results.flow_input_to_sink: Caller context (msg.sender) invokes permissionless releaseSponsorPrize() and is recorded as the indexed caller parameter in the SponsorPrizeReleased event, while the escrowed ERC-721 transfer targets the stored prizeToken, prizeTokenId, and sponsorRecipient configured at initialization.
results.flow_security_relevance: Executes an external call to the sponsor-configured ERC-721 contract (prizeToken.transferFrom) and verifies ownership (prizeToken.ownerOf) to return the escrowed NFT to sponsorRecipient in CashWon or Refunding states. Deserves security review for external interaction with arbitrary ERC-721 implementations, potential reentrancy or griefing vectors, absence of runtime _isProtocolDestination screening on sponsorRecipient (unlike _transferQuote), and independence from quote-token settlement (settlementComplete)…
results.flow_summary: Permissionless release of the escrowed ERC-721 prize token back to the configured sponsorRecipient when the raffle is in Status.CashWon or Status.Refunding and prizeClaimed is false, marking prizeClaimed = true, transferring the token via transferFrom, verifying post-transfer ownership, and emitting SponsorPrizeReleased.
results.flow_terminal_action: Transfers prizeTokenId on prizeToken from address(this) to sponsorRecipient via IERC721.transferFrom, verifies prizeToken.ownerOf(prizeTokenId) == sponsorRecipient, and emits SponsorPrizeReleased(msg.sender, recipient, address(prizeToken), prizeTokenId).
